newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN WINS 500CC JAPANESE GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN WINS 500CC JAPANESE GRAND PRIX.

text.p: Reigning world champion Michael Doohan of Australia, riding a Honda, won the 500cc Japanese Grand Prix on Sunday in 45 minutes 11.995 seconds.
Spain's Alex Criville was second followed by Japan's Tadayuki Okada, both riding a Honda. Both riders belong to the same Repsol Honda team as Doohan.
In the 250cc category, wild card rider Daijiro Kato from Japan, also riding a Honda, earned his first win in a time of 41 minutes 42.226 seconds.
Japan's Noboru Ueda won the 125cc category in a time of 41 minutes 48.072 seconds.
